title: A Recorder for Fieldwork
transcript:
Hi. I’m in the first-year geography class. Can I borrow a recorder for our river project?
Of course. When do you need it?
We’re going out on Saturday. I was hoping to collect it Friday afternoon.
The desk closes at three on Fridays. Come before then and bring your student card.
Can I keep it until Wednesday?
Normally we lend them for two days, but the desk is closed at weekends. Bring it back by noon on Monday.
That’s fine. Do I need to buy batteries?
No. You’ll get a spare set in the case.

questions.prompt: What does the student want to borrow?
questions.explanation: 学生开头说明，河流调研项目需要借一台录音设备。

questions.prompt: When is the equipment due back?
questions.explanation: 设备台周末不开门，工作人员要求周一中午前归还。
